verdicts.missing: The quote states only that Django 4.1 supports MariaDB 10.3 and higher. It does not say that MariaDB 10.2 support is dropped in 4.1, although that is implied. The upgrade crossing 4.1 is a deployment hypothesis.

The quote says only that upstream support for MariaDB 10.2 ends in May 2022. It does not say Django 4.1 drops MariaDB 10.2 or requires 10.3+, and it does not establish that a deployment on 10.2 is affected by the Django upgrade.
